description: Originally designed to test the effects of temporal translation on starships, the U.S.S. Relativity was embroiled in controversy when Captain Braxton used it to make an attempt on Captain Janeway's life. Now, the vessel has been given a new purpose in the fight against the Krenim.

ship_ability.title: Anti-Tachyon Weaponry
ship_ability.description: Increases base Damage against Krenim Invading Entities by {value}
